issue.title: 3 agent-loader tests fail since 548bbe9284: Tier 1 recent_completed_limit is now 2000 and the navigation prefix refresh was removed

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Reproduced deterministically (3/3 fail, `-p no:randomly`, no parallel load) on master 4f4764b42d while landing epic sase-1ca; the sase-1ca.2 phase worker also saw the identical failure on its clean base tree. The assertions pin behavior that commit 548bbe9284 ("fix startup missing rows with baseline inbox and roster completion", plan 202609/agents_startup_missing_rows.md) changed on purpose:

- `tests/ace/tui/actions/test_agent_loader_phase5_index_wiring.py::test_load_agents_from_disk_uses_artifact_index_for_initial_tier` and `::test_viewport_window_keeps_tier1_caps` assert `query.recent_completed_limit == 200`, but 548bbe9284 made Tier 1 baseline use `_TIER1_VISIBLE_COMPLETED_LIMIT` (2000) in `src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_loader_artifacts.py`.
- `tests/ace/tui/actions/test_agent_search_history_split.py::test_bounded_agents_viewport_expands_near_prefix_end` asserts `app.async_refresh_sources == ["navigation"]`, but 548bbe9284 removed the lazy prefix-completion (navigation) refresh path and coalesced Tier 2 reconcile into the baseline path, so the list is now `[]`.

Likely fix: update the three tests to the new baseline contract (or delete the prefix-expansion test if its behavior no longer exists). Confirm against the plan that the code, not the test, reflects intent.

Proposed by: sase-1ca.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1), routed by the sase-1ca land agent.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1ca.2 recorded these as pre-existing failures; the sase-1ca land agent reproduced them deterministically on master and traced them to 548bbe9284, which no active epic owns.
